title: Dashboard load performance and multi-currency balance display
description: Validate that the dashboard loads within 3 seconds and displays balances separately for each active user currency.

steps.description: Login with a valid user account having multiple active currencies.
Navigate to the dashboard page.
Verify the dashboard loads in under 3 seconds.
Check that balances for all active currencies are displayed separately and correctly.

title: Create transaction with positive amount and multi-currency support
description: Ensure a user can create a transaction with a positive amount, valid type, selected currency, and automatic ARS conversion calculation.

steps.description: Navigate to transaction creation form.
Input a valid positive amount, select a valid transaction type (income or expense), and select a non-ARS currency.
Submit the transaction form.
Verify transaction is saved with the correct amount and currency.
Check that the equivalent amount in ARS is calculated and stored automatically.

title: Transaction creation with invalid amount (negative or zero)
description: Check that creation of transactions with zero or negative amounts is prevented and an error is shown.

steps.description: Open the new transaction form.
Enter a zero amount and valid transaction type and currency.
Submit the form.
Ensure the form shows an error indicating amount must be positive.
Repeat the above steps with a negative amount.
Confirm same error is shown for negative amount.

title: Export transactions with filters and correct totals
description: Validate that exporting transactions for a selected month includes all filtered transactions and shows correct total exported amount.

steps.description: Navigate to transaction export section.
Select a specific month and apply some filters (e.g., category, currency).
Export transactions in both CSV and Excel formats.
Verify exported files contain all transactions matching filters for the month.
Check that the total amount in the export matches the sum of the filtered transactions.

title: Session timeout warning and automatic logout after inactivity
description: Ensure a modal warning appears 2 minutes before automatic logout and user is logged out after 10 minutes of inactivity.

steps.description: Login and remain inactive for 8 minutes.
Confirm session timeout warning modal is shown.
Ignore the modal and stay inactive for additional 2 minutes.
Verify automatic logout occurs and user is returned to login screen.

title: Create, edit, activate/deactivate, reorder custom user currencies
description: Verify full CRUD and ordering capabilities for user-customizable currencies including activation and deactivation.

steps.description: Navigate to currency management.
Create a new custom currency with required fields.
Check the new currency appears in the list.
Edit the currency details.
Verify changes are saved and reflected.
Deactivate the currency.
Confirm currency is marked inactive and no longer counts towards balances.
Reorder currencies placing the new currency first.
Validate the new order is saved and displayed accordingly.

title: Categories management with icon, color, filters, and budget
description: Check user can create, edit, activate/deactivate categories with icon & color selection and that filters by type work.

steps.description: Navigate to category management.
Create a new expense category with icon and color.
Verify category appears with correct icon and color.
Set a budget for the new category.
Ensure budget saves correctly.
Filter categories by type income and expense.
Check that the filtering shows only correct categories.
Deactivate and reactivate a category.
Verify category status changes and it is hidden or visible accordingly.

title: Payment methods management CRUD and active status
description: Validate creation, edition, activation/deactivation, and deletion of payment methods including cash, cards, and transfers.

steps.description: Open payment methods management screen.
Create a new payment method specifying type and details.
Check the new method appears in the list.
Edit the payment method.
Confirm changes are saved.
Deactivate the payment method.
Validate method is marked inactive and excluded where appropriate.
Delete the payment method.
Verify method is removed from the list.

title: Create and track savings goals with multi-currency and auto contributions
description: Ensure users can create saving goals, monitor progress with accurate visuals across multiple currencies, and that automatic contributions reflect correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to savings goals section.
Create a new savings goal with target amount and currency.
Confirm the goal is listed with correct target and initial progress.
Make transactions linked to the savings goal.
Verify the progress visual updates accordingly.
Simulate auto contribution deductions from linked transactions.
Confirm auto contributions are reflected on the goal's balance and progress.

title: Transactions flagged as credit card expenses do not affect balance until card payment
description: Verify that transactions marked with is_credito=true do not modify user balance until the corresponding credit card statement is paid.

steps.description: Create a transaction flagged as credit card expense.
Check that overall user balance does not decrease.
Record payment of the credit card statement.
Validate a new expense transaction is created reflecting payment.
Confirm the user balance is updated by the payment amount.

title: Pay credit card statement updates and links related transactions
description: Check that paying a credit card statement creates an expense transaction and marks associated transactions with the actual payment date.

steps.description: Navigate to credit card statement payment screen.
Mark a pending statement as paid.
Verify creation of a corresponding expense transaction.
Confirm all transactions linked to the statement have their payment date updated accordingly.

title: Responsive UI for forms and widgets on mobile devices
description: Ensure all forms and dashboard widgets are fully responsive and usable on various mobile screen sizes.

steps.description: Access the app from multiple device simulators with varying screen sizes (small phones, tablets).
Open transaction forms, category management, currency management, savings goals, and dashboard widgets.
Verify forms adapt their layout properly, all input elements are accessible and usable.
Confirm dashboard widgets resize and rearrange for optimal readability and interaction.

title: Dashboard real-time updates after transaction changes
description: Verify that adding, editing, or deleting transactions updates the dashboard balances and charts in real-time.

steps.description: Open dashboard and note current balances and charts.
Add a new income transaction.
Check dashboard updates to reflect new transaction.
Edit the transaction amount.
Verify dashboard updates to changed amount.
Delete the transaction.
Confirm dashboard removes the corresponding data.

title: Error handling for expired JWT tokens and session management
description: Make sure system handles expired JWT tokens gracefully with appropriate logout and error messaging.

steps.description: Simulate an expired JWT token during an API request.
Verify user is logged out and redirected to login page.
Check that user sees an informative error message regarding session expiration.

title: Filter and search on transaction and payment methods lists
description: Validate filtering and searching capabilities work correctly on transactions and payment methods listings.

steps.description: Navigate to transactions list and apply filters (date, category, currency).
Confirm list shows only transactions matching filters.
Search transactions by description keyword.
Validate search results are correct.
Go to payment methods list and filter active and inactive methods.
Verify filtering shows correct subset.
